# decode_times { #spikepack.decode_times }

```python
decode_times(deltas, meta)
```

Invert `encode_times`.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                                     | Default    |
|--------|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| deltas | np.ndarray | Delta-encoded integer ticks, as returned by `encode_times`.                     | _required_ |
| meta   | dict       | Metadata dict returned by `encode_times` (`quantization_us`, `origin_seconds`). | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                                                                    |
|--------|------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | np.ndarray | Reconstructed event times in seconds (`float64`), equal to the input times to within half a quantization step. |
